name: Mayan
long_description: We help Amazon sellers grow their business with our data-driven automations. We are starting out with advertising and inventory. From there, we're moving to other avenues that help accelerate brand growth!
one_liner: A growth automation platform for Amazon sellers

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
I'm an MIT graduate who has worked in several startups as a data-driven impactful employee. The startups have been in the incubator, ed-tech, then video advertising spaces, with all of them based in Boston. 

Mayan is my first venture, co-founded with two friends from MIT. I live near Las Vegas with my wife and 2-yr old son.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
4× founder (2× technical COO, 2× technical co-founder). Built and scaled products from 0→1 and 1→n while running all the “everything else” — ops, GTM, fundraising, hiring, and special projects.

Thrive in high-ambiguity, high-speed environments. Founder who can operate without ego, integrate quickly, and move the needle fast. I help companies clear bottlenecks, deliver cross-functional initiatives end-to-end, and create the operating systems that keep growth on track.
